decision_rule: R3/R4/R5 line rules (battery R3-lines and R5-lines-A): a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp written as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact, lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; a clause on the source page but on no row is corrected. Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached (no live page, no archive). 'listed <date>' for UKG/Paylocity board stamps is allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17); 'read <Month> [<day>,] <year>' is allowed where a cited row's retrieved_date carries it. Live = the role is in the board's own list or search today (a rendering detail page alone is not enough). A qualifier or causal link that is on the source page but on no row is corrected (same rule). A city-only posting posed as a question to the plant, not placed at it, is not a site error.
scope: Every opening_line and bottleneck_guess in ledger/inbox/mining-lines-M3.json (12 plants, 24 lines) and mining-lines-M4.json (11 plants, 22 lines): 23 plants, 46 lines; 45 text lines checked (30 on 15 High/Medium plants; 15 on 8 Low plants: Mine Rite, Coperion Sabetha, Kansas City and Whitewater, Bobcat Bismarck, TAG, Liebherr, Quality Urbandale); 1 set to 'unknown' (Bobcat Bismarck bottleneck) counted separately.
error_rate_note: 2/45 = 4.4% corrected on all text lines; High/Medium 1/30 = 3.3% (Derrick Buffalo bottleneck; the Liebherr correction is on a Low plant). Both corrections are a page-only qualifier or link carried by no row; no corrected line moves a score. 1 line unreachable (Rockland Bedford bottleneck guess: its Fitter Fabricator posting closed, no archive). Not-confirmed rate incl. unreachable: 3/45 = 6.7% all, 2/30 = 6.7% High/Medium. Excluding unreachable from the denominator: 2/44 = 4.5%. Unknown lines (1) not in any denominator.
